title: Meeting With The Humble Beings, O Siblings
summary: Anger is named plainly here before the mind has time to decorate it.
takeaway: Meeting with the humble beings, O Siblings of Destiny, the Messenger of Death is conquered
lifeApplication: Slow the tongue before you defend the self-image behind it. Begin with the part of the day already in front of you.
